item.title: Major leak causing damage, 24th August
item.description:
There has been a mains water leak one the pavement for over two weeks. The leak has been reported to Thames Water on numerous occasions. The leak is now coming out of the raised flower bed, and has caused damage to the wall. Bricks have fallen off and been thrown around by teenagers. Yesterday, an elderly gentleman slipped where the water has been collecting. Luckily, he was not badly hurt but was very shaken.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Blackfen, Greater London
